rules.title: 📖 GAME RULES
rules.goalText: Be the only player left. Others go bankrupt or leave.
rules.props1: After buying a property you can build houses (up to 4)
rules.props2: Collect the full color group – you can build
rules.rentText: Landing on someone else's property – you pay rent. More houses = higher rent.
rules.jail3: 3 doubles in a row → to jail
rules.bankruptText: When you can't pay – sell property to the bank (80%). If still not enough – you go bankrupt. You can declare bankruptcy (give up) at any time – it's the only way to leave the game.
rules.afkText: If you don't roll within 60 s, your move is made automatically. If you stay inactive, the time gets shorter (20 s, then 5 s), and after 10 automatic moves you go bankrupt. If you close the browser, you have 5 min to return, otherwise you go bankrupt.
rules.auctionText: You can sell a property at auction. The bank offers 70% starting price. Other players can outbid.
rules.tradeText: Offer another player properties + money. Exchange, negotiate.
rules.voteText: If a player is disruptive – you can vote. Majority needed. Removed – loses everything.
